
Where <numerical_answer> is the numerical answer to the problem.

How much money does Brady have in his piggy bank in dollars? Brady has 100 pennies in his piggy bank. Brady has 40 nickels in his piggy bank. Brady has 20 dimes in his piggy bank. Brady has 40 pieces of dollar bills in his piggy bank.
